heard: A pitch-black planet is being eaten alive by its star. Discovered in 2008, Wasp-12b is a hot Jupiter orbiting its star every 1.1 days. The planet sits just 2 million miles away, locked in a permanent dayside. Extreme gravitational forces have distorted this world into an egg shape. Dayside temperatures reach up to 4,700 degrees Fahrenheit. This intense heat allows the world to absorb 94% of starlight, making it as dark as fresh asphalt. Its atmosphere has ballooned to nearly three times the radius of Jupiter, spilling material directly onto the host star. Astronomers estimate this doomed world has only a few million years left before it is completely destroyed. A star is actively consuming a pitch-black planet.
